_comment: Staged v2 routing config for this library. NOT yet live: the watcher still parses routing.json as v1, so replacing routing.json with this file before the watcher is wired to scripts/cbz_routing.py would break routing. Until then this is the single home for manual series decisions, read by scripts/cbz_library_reclassify.py via --routing.
_comment_default: Graphic Novels is the fallback. The adult signal this waited on now exists (#31), so adult sources such as HentaiNexus are classified rather than reaching Comix only by being the default. Still not live: the watcher parses routing.json as v1 and there is no active v2 mode, so nothing here routes anything yet. Activation is a separate, separately reviewed decision with its own remaining gates.

lists._comment_publishers: Japanese/Korean publishers and licensors, taken from ComicInfo actually observed in the library rather than guessed.
lists._comment_sites: Aggregator/scanlation domains seen in the Web field. Several correspond to entries in the curated source list the v1 routing.json already maintained.
lists._comment_western_sites: Negative evidence. An aggregator URL that names a Western publisher outweighs a genre word, which is the failure mode that misfiled Ice Cream Man.
lists._comment_adult_evidence: The three evidence classes of the accepted adult signal, derived from the 2026-08-03 census (issue #31). 125 features in total: 59 domains, 60 SourceMihon values, 6 Categories tokens. Reproduced verbatim from adult_candidates_v2.json rather than retyped. See _comment_adult_signal on the signal itself for the measured coverage and both false-positive rates.
lists._comment_adult_domains: Matched with domain_in_list, which parses the host out of the Web value exactly as the census did (scheme, www. and port stripped, then casefolded). Not glob_in_list: that matches anywhere in the URL, so a query parameter naming one of these would classify another site's series as adult.
lists._comment_adult_provenance: xsd:SourceMihon values, whole-field exact match. `komga` is deliberately absent and must stay absent: it means the archive was re-imported from the Komga library, so inferring adult status from it would infer the answer from the current placement. The watcher's own COMICINFO_TEMPLATE writes SourceMihon=Komga, so this exclusion is load-bearing against this repository's own writes, not only against re-imports.
lists._comment_adult_categories: xsd:Categories tokens. The field is comma-joined, so glob_tokens_in_list splits on the comma and matches each token; none of these six values contains a glob metacharacter, so the match is exact token equality, which is what the census measured. Adding a value containing * or ? here would widen it into pattern matching.

signals._comment_adult_signal: The accepted adult signal (#31), measured on the 2026-08-03 census. Coverage 17,096/17,468 Comix series = 97.87%. Negative control 646 Manga/Graphic Novels series, three of which match. TWO RATES, NOT INTERCHANGEABLE: raw 3/646 = 0.46% counts every negative match before adjudication; adjudicated 2/646 = 0.31% counts confirmed errors only. The signal was accepted at adjudicated precision >= 0.99, so 0.31% is the operative rate and 0.46% must never be quoted as the false-positive rate of this signal. The difference is ERIKA (domain:pururin.me), adjudicated a TRUE POSITIVE -- a mixed folder holding 3 confirmed adult archives among 9 horror ones, unresolved pending an archive-level split -- and therefore not counted in the confirmed false-positive numerator. The negative-control denominator remains 646 for BOTH rates: the adjudication changes what counts as an error, not the size of the population measured. derive_adult.py prints len(fp_rows)/len(neg) with len(neg) fixed at 646 for both. This is easy to get wrong because a 645 denominator rounds to the same 0.31%, so the percentage alone cannot tell the two readings apart -- which is why every rate here is written as an explicit fraction and never as a bare percentage. The two confirmed false positives are Kichiku Hero (category:extra gooey) and The Eminence in Shadow I NEED MORE POWER! (category:gooey). Support >= 5 Comix series; a sweep down to support 1 was measured and rejected, 92 extra features buying 13 series (97.87% -> 97.94%). Unrelated coincidence: AgeRating's negative-pool presence is also 3/646 = 0.46%, a different measurement entirely.

rules._comment_explicitly_adult: Was a placeholder matching AgeRating in [Adults Only 18+, X18+], which the August 2026 census found matched zero of 18,119 series -- neither value occurs in this library, where the only AgeRating present is Mature 17+ on 3 series. Replaced in #31 by the validated Categories + SourceMihon + Web provenance signal above, which is measured rather than assumed. AgeRating is no longer consulted for adult classification and expanding it is not the way to widen this signal.
rules.name: explicit adult content

_comment_overrides: Manual decisions. Ice Cream Man is an Image Comics title that carries the scraped genre 'seinen,Comedy'; that tag had already misfiled a copy into X:\Manga before this migration, so it is pinned here to fix both copies and to stop the tag doing it again.
